---
title: Egg and Cheese
id: MAR-0035
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 50
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 150 g semolina
- 100 g fontina cheese
- 80 g butter
- 4 dl meat broth
- 40 g Grana Padano
- 30 g breadcrumbs
- 4 egg yolks
- 1 black truffle
## Method
1. Pour the broth into a small saucepan, heat it and, before it begins to boil, gradually add the semolina, beating with a fork to prevent lumps from forming.
2. Cook for 15-20 minutes, until the semolina is cooked, adding more boiling broth if necessary.
3. The semolina should not be added when the liquid is boiling but just before, to avoid the formation of lumps.
4. Turn off the heat, incorporate 70 g of butter and the Grana Padano.
5. Grease four cylindrical molds with the remaining butter, sprinkle them internally with the breadcrumbs and pour two-thirds of the semolina, spreading it with a wet spoon also on the walls of the container.
6. Slice the fontina cheese and distribute half of it in the molds, into which you will also pour the egg yolks, the remaining cheese, the well-brushed black truffle cut into thin slices, finishing with the remaining semolina.
7. Bake the preparation at 180 °C for 5-6 minutes; unmold onto individual plates and serve.
